claude.rationale: The customer-facing product (T4) — the Advantage brand name, website, phone numbers, trademarks and copyrights — crossed the boundary, but the transaction was structured as a selected-asset purchase that "did not transfer an intact producing/delivering organization," with delivery instead run through the acquirer's own corporate locations and operating processes; this is a documented product-vs-process structural mismatch at closing (gap_45=1). Because the operational processes were not transferred from Advantage but supplied by the acquirer's existing organization, no separate T5 process re-engineering occurred without its corresponding people/culture, so gap_56=0. The slice further states no transition-services or operating agreement bridged the former operating substrate, so the T4/T5 gap was not contractually absorbed (gap_mitigated=no).

gemini.rationale: The transaction transferred the Advantage brand (T4) and selected operational assets like leases and concessions (T5), so there is no documented gap_45. However, the operational assets (T5) transferred without any of the workforce or management (T6), creating a structural gap_56. No transition services agreement was documented to mitigate this gap.

grok.rationale: The slice states the deal transferred the Advantage brand identity (name, website, phone numbers, trademarks, copyrights) as the customer-facing asset while structuring only an option on selected leases, fixed assets and airport concessions for ~20 locations, and that the brand was thereafter run through the acquirer's own corporate locations and operating processes with no intact Advantage producing organization transferred. That is a documented T4-without-seller-T5 structural mismatch at closing (gap_45=1). gap_56=0 because Advantage operational processes did not transfer as a package that then lacked people; the acquirer used its own processes and organization, and the FY2009 primary describes no workforce/management transfer and no TSA or shared-substrate bridge.
